params.body:
Follow-up to #4: a few things that make the static site feel current, and two visual cleanups.

## Open now

- The header shows whether the café is open: "Nu open, tot 24.00", "Gesloten, open om 10.30", "Gesloten, morgen open om 10.30" or "Gesloten, vrijdag open om 10.30". On a phone only the first part ("Nu open", "Gesloten") fits beside the menu button. A moss dot when open, ink-soft when closed.
- Worked out in the visitor's browser (`src/lib/openStatus.ts`) from the Studio opening hours in Brussels time, so a page built days ago is still right. A closing time at or before the opening time runs past midnight: Saturday 10.30 to 2.00 still reads open on Sunday at 1.30.
- Today's row in the footer hours is set in bold.
- Without JavaScript or without opening hours, nothing is shown.

## Agenda

The calendar sheet from the home band is now a `DateSheet` component, used large on the home page and small beside each upcoming event on the agenda. Time and admission sit under the title.

## Cleanups

- The footer map is toned to the site's paper and ink (`map-tint`: greyscale plus a little sepia). The coloured Google map was the loudest thing on every page.
- The drawing's paper was not quite white, so under the multiply blend its edge showed as a grey patch at the bottom left. The paper is lifted to pure white (linear 1.09); the file is re-encoded and goes from 268 KB to 214 KB.

## Checked

- `astro build` against the live dataset (read only) and `tsc --noEmit`, both clean.
- `openStatus` against six moments: Thursday afternoon (closed day), Friday before opening, Friday evening, Sunday 1.30 (Saturday's late closing), Sunday 2.30, Wednesday just after midnight.
- Desktop and phone screenshots of the header, agenda and footer, with the map loaded.
params.title: Open-now status, calendar sheets on the agenda, quieter map
